title: Update Buff Priorities
notes: R1748000: on the field a Nerf or a Buff draws neither the cost row nor a declared number only the card's Cry reads (Param.cry, 64 numbers on 45 cards). R1748001: a Buff's keyword row gives a Field Spell Indestructible and a Spell or Field Spell marked dealsDamage (35 cards) Pierce or Lifesteal. R1748002: on the field a Buff places a Plague Counter on a Field Spell marked usesPlague (Corpse Plantation, The House, Forbiddenous Factory) and a Nerf removes one. R1748003: every Spell and Field Spell audited; eleven declare numbers they printed (Hinder, Reoccurring Dream, Eugenics, Call to Arms, Zao Gao, Outbreak, Claude's Datacenter, CN in a Bottle, H1B Printer, Wondrous Wand, Grubby Gloves), each keeping its v0.4.4b script for replays, and a census test names why the rest stay fixed.

player.title: Buffs and Nerfs choose better
changes: A Buff or a Nerf on a card on the field no longer changes its cost, nor a number only its Cry uses.
A Buff can give a Field Spell Indestructible, and a Spell or Field Spell that deals damage Pierce or Lifesteal.
On the field, a Buff places a Plague Counter on Corpse Plantation, The House or Forbiddenous Factory, and a Nerf removes one.
Buffs and Nerfs can now change Hinder's discard, Reoccurring Dream's and Eugenics' chances, Call to Arms' Units, Zao Gao's Rush Tokens and Outbreak's draws.
They can also change the cost CN in a Bottle, Claude's Datacenter, H1B Printer, Wondrous Wand and Grubby Gloves give the cards they add.
